definition: to attack in a forceful, violent, hostile or aggressive way.
example_en: The enemies attacked the town violently.

definition: a preparation; plan; arrangements.
example_en: They made preparations for the pilgrimage.

definition: to join together by settling or arranging rightly.
example_en: They joined the two ropes together and tied them firmly.

definition: an offensive attack; aggression; invasion.
example_en: The enemy's invasion happened suddenly.

definition: (biol.) the theory that the embryo, influenced by its internal and external environment, develops progressively by stages, forming structures that were not originally present in the egg; epigenesis.
example: ಅನುಜನನ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಭ್ರೂಣ ಹಂತಹಂತವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: According to the theory of epigenesis, the embryo develops stage by stage.

definition: a blow; the impact of a blow; a stroke.
example_en: He received a hard blow on his back.

definition: āṣāḍha, the fourth month of the solar calendar followed in some parts of India.
example: ಆಡಿ ತಿಂಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಳೆ ಸುರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: It rains in this region during the month of Ashadha.

definition: to comprise as a part of; to take in; to include.
example_en: This book also includes grammar as a part.

definition: the act of giving.
example_en: His act of giving helped the poor.

definition: any piece of certain kinds of material, as iron, that has the property of attracting like material; a magnet.
example_en: The magnet attracted the iron needle.

definition: wet, soft earth or earthy matter, as on the ground after rain, at the bottom of a pond or along the banks of a river; mire; mud.
example_en: After the rain, the field was filled with mud.

definition: personification of the absolute Consciousness.
example_en: The Upanishads describe the personification of the absolute Consciousness.

definition: to walk with long strides.
example_en: He walked out of the house in anger, striding with long steps.

definition: the science of numbers; arithmetic.
example_en: Knowledge of arithmetic was necessary for the merchants' children.

definition: a betting in advance on the outcome of a fight, race, competition, contest, etc.
example_en: People placed advance bets on the contest even before it began.

definition: the plant Anisochilus carnosus of Lamiaceae family; thick leaved lavender.
example_en: The leaves of kapparavaḷḷi have a strong fragrance.

definition: a leaf of a palmyra tree.
example_en: They measured the rice in a palmyra leaf.

definition: a thick rope, cable made of intertwisted strands of fibre, thin wires, etc.
example_en: They used a thick rope to tie the boat to the shore.

definition: fully blown, expanded (as a flower).
example_en: The fully blown roses shone beautifully in the garden.

definition: to split lengthwise.
example_en: The cook split the cucumber lengthwise.

definition: firmness; fixedness.
example_en: A certain firmness was evident in his words.

definition: a cot made of ropes or cords.
example_en: Grandfather rested placing the rope cot in the courtyard.

definition: to follow the footprints of.
example_en: The hunter followed the tiger's footprints into the forest.

definition: the movement of an orbiting celestial object (as the moon or an artificial satellite) completely around the earth; revolution around the earth.
example: ಚಂದ್ರನ ಭೂಭ್ರಮಣ ಸುಮಾರು ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತೊಂಬತ್ತು ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The moon's revolution around the earth completes in about twenty-nine days.

definition: that which is situated at the end.
example_en: The final state means the last stage.

definition: a place for public contest of wrestling; an arena.
example_en: The wrestlers fought each other in the arena.

definition: a piece split from a whole or a bigger one; a split.
example_en: A split piece got separated from the rock.

definition: (dogs) to bark.
example_en: The dogs were barking at night.

definition: of different kinds or varieties.
example_en: She made various kinds of sweets.

definition: a natural stream of water of fairly large size, flowing in a definite course, emptying into an ocean, lake or another river; a river.
example_en: The river flows beside the village.

definition: the state of being cut, broken or minced into small piece.
example_en: From the blow, the glass broke into small pieces.

definition: in the shape of a circle; round; circular.
example_en: The design of that building is circular in shape.

definition: a short leg (as of human beings, table etc.).
example_en: That chair had one short leg.

definition: a particular game of chance played with stakes.
example: ಹಬ್ಬದ ದಿನ ಗ್ರಾಮಸ್ಥರು ಬಾರಗುತ್ತು ಆಟ ಆಡಿದರು.
example_en: On the festival day the villagers played the game of chance.

definition: intense anger; rage; ire; fury.
example_en: Hearing the insult, intense anger arose in him.

definition: a false or spurious imitation; something not genuine; an artificial thing.
example_en: Spurious imitation jewellery was being sold in the market.

definition: the sprinkling of water on the floor (as to keep the dust from raising up).
example: ಅತಿಥಿಗಳು ಬರುವ ಮೊದಲು ಅಂಗಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಳಯ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: Before the guests arrived, they sprinkled water on the courtyard floor.

definition: a valiant fighter or soldier.
example_en: The valiant soldier protected the fort from the enemies.

definition: the horizontal crosspiece of the door frame; the lintel.
example_en: The carpenter fixed the lintel to the door.

definition: to tread heavily; to trample.
example: ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಹೂದೋಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಡೆಮೆಟ್ಟಿ ಹೂಗಳನ್ನು ಹಾಳು ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: The children trampled in the flower garden and ruined the flowers.

definition: a group of persons, forming a recognisable unit.
example_en: A group of youths went along the street shouting.

definition: the base of a building; the foundation.
example_en: The foundation of this house is very strong.

definition: a pair of drawing compasses with legs joined by a flexible steel band, the angle between being adjusted by a screw; a bow-compass.
example_en: He used a bow-compass to draw the picture.

definition: to press with the foot or feet.
example_en: He pressed the ball with his foot.

definition: to catch up something (that is going or progressing ahead) and go or progress beyond.
example: ಆ ಬಂಡಿ ಇತರ ಬಂಡಿಗಳನ್ನು ಪಿಂದಿಕ್ಕಿ ಮುಂದೆ ಹೋಯಿತು.
example_en: That cart overtook the other carts and moved ahead.

definition: the act or an instance of beginning; commencement.
example_en: The inauguration ceremony of the new school took place grandly.

definition: the tree Symplocos racemosa of Symplocaceae family.
example_en: The Symplocos racemosa tree grows near water.

definition: to teach, instruct or educate.
example_en: The teacher taught the children moral lessons.

definition: to move the thumb on the middle finger producing a snapping sound; to snap the fingers.
example_en: He snapped his fingers and called the boy.

definition: the deed that one is yet to or will, commit.
example_en: The deed yet to be committed depends on present conduct.

definition: the egg of a louse; a nit.
example_en: A nit was found in her hair.

definition: a pleasing smell or odour; a sweet scent.
example_en: A pleasing fragrance spread everywhere from the flower garden.

definition: to become still, stationary.
example_en: Out of fear, he became still in one place.

definition: a lid that covers only partially.
example_en: That vessel had only a half-covering lid.

definition: the act of spying; espionage.
example: ಆ ಸೈನಿಕ ಶತ್ರುಶಿಬಿರದ ಬೇಹು ಕಾರ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿರತನಾಗಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That soldier was engaged in the work of espionage on the enemy camp.

definition: name of a state, now officially and popularly known as Mahārāṣṭra, in Western India, having Mumbai as its capital.
example_en: Shivaji was the founder of the Maratha kingdom.

definition: the quality, state or fact of being certain; a firm mental conception.
example_en: Firm certainty was clearly visible in his words.

definition: sexual sport and intercourse.
example_en: The couple were absorbed in sexual sport.

definition: any of those persons who choose to suffer or die rather than give up their faith or principles; a martyr.
example: ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಲವು ಹುತಾತ್ಮರು ಪ್ರಾಣ ತ್ಯಾಗ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: Many martyrs sacrificed their lives in the freedom struggle.

definition: a tail that is bent (as that of a dog).
example_en: That dog had a bent, curled tail.

definition: something that is covered, wrapped.
example_en: The baby's body was covered with a cloth.

definition: a set of two thing that are alike.
example_en: Those two brothers look like a matching pair (twins).

definition: well-knit; well-built; construstructed well.
example_en: That bridge is constructed well and sturdily.

definition: a person lacking minimum quantity of food in daily life for survival.
example: ಆ ಬಡ ನಿರಾಹಾರಿ ದಿನಗಟ್ಟಲೆ ಆಹಾರವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಬದುಕಿದನು.
example_en: That poor food-deprived man lived for days without food.

definition: the act or process of becoming mature or ripe.
example_en: The ripening of the mango happened quickly in the sun.

definition: to become dry; to lose moisture or dampness.
example_en: Clothes dry quickly in the sun.

definition: (lion) to roar.
example_en: The lion, king of the forest, roared.

definition: that which is built with mortar, cement, etc.
example_en: The mortar-built wall had developed cracks.

definition: a proclaiming of an order.
example_en: The king proclaimed the order everywhere.

definition: an order; a command; a behest.
example_en: Disobeying the king's order is a crime.

definition: a material or materials needed commonly by common people, as grains, other food items, etc. sold in a store; goods.
example_en: The shopkeeper raised the price of the goods.

definition: a thing or things owned (by a person); possessions collectively; property.
example_en: All his possessions went to his children.

definition: one who chases.
example_en: That chaser pursued and caught the thief.

definition: a man holding a spear.
example_en: The man holding a spear stood guard at the gate.

definition: an elevated land; a highland.
example_en: The whole valley can be seen from the village's highland.

definition: any affair that can be dealt legally under civil law.
example_en: The dispute over that land was settled under civil law.

definition: to see or know beforehand; to foresee.
example_en: The wise are able to foresee the danger that is coming.

definition: a risk, peril, danger or jeopardy; a hazard.
example_en: There are many dangers in this journey.

definition: to cause to exact, extort.
example: ಜಮೀನುದಾರ ಬಡ ರೈತರಿಂದ ಬಲವಂತವಾಗಿ ಹಣ ಸುಲಿಯಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The landlord had money forcibly extorted from the poor farmers.

definition: a woman who cannot conceive a child after bearing the first.
example_en: She became unable to conceive again after her first child.

definition: to come out.
example_en: He slowly came out through the door.

definition: a man who deposits money in a bank; a depositor.
example_en: That depositor had deposited money in the bank.

definition: a building where a person or family normally lives; a house.
example_en: This is our grandmother's old house.

definition: the back or hind part; backside.
example_en: There is a waterfall on the backside of the hill.

definition: a piece of certain kind of material that has the property of attracting iron; a magnet.
example_en: The magnet attracted the iron needles.

definition: white crystals of frozen water which usu. forms a layer of flakes; snow.
example_en: Snow had fallen on the mountaintop.

definition: a piece of land that is pledged.
example: ಸಾಲಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಒತ್ತೆಮಣ್ಣನ್ನು ಗಿರವಿ ಇಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: He pledged his mortgaged land for the loan.

definition: a person who tends and herds cattle, as his occupation; a cowherd.
example: ಆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬ ದನಗ ದನಗಳನ್ನು ಮೇಯಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: In that village, a cowherd was grazing the cattle.

definition: Śiva, the benevolent deity.
example_en: The devotees prayed for the grace of the benevolent Shiva.

definition: a gift; donation.
example_en: They distributed rice as a donation to the poor.

definition: the plant Phoebe wightii of Lauraceae family.
example: ಆ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕುರಮಾವು ಮರಗಳಿಂದ ನೆರಳು ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Shade is provided by the kuramavu trees in that forest.

definition: to float - a) to stay on the surface of a liquid; b) to drift or move slowly or easily on water.
example_en: The dry leaves were floating along in the stream water.

definition: a sacrifice addressed to the fire-god, Agni.
example_en: The brahmins used to perform the fire-sacrifice every day.

definition: a endowment income from which is exempt from taxation; a tax-exempt gift.
example_en: This land belonged to the temple as a tax-exempt endowment.

definition: an elephant (Elephas maximus).
example_en: A large elephant was walking in the forest.

definition: a pleasing smell or odour.
example: ಆ ಹೂದೋಟದಿಂದ ಸೌಸವ ಗಾಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ತೇಲಿ ಬಂತು.
example_en: A pleasing odour floated in the air from that flower garden.

definition: to have a military accompanying oneself.
example_en: Before setting out for war, the king had his army accompany him.

definition: mighty Hanumān, the son of Wind-God, who served Rāma, in Řmāyaṇa, the great Indian epic.
example_en: Mighty Hanuman served Rama with devotion.

definition: to move forward by or as by crawling.
example_en: The baby crawled and played on the ground.

definition: a change of an era.
example: ಆ ಆವಿಷ್ಕಾರ ಇಡೀ ಸಮಾಜದಲ್ಲಿ ಯುಗಪರಿವರ್ತನ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: That invention brought about a change of era in the whole society.

definition: skilful in deception; sly; crafty; cunning.
example_en: That cunning merchant was cheating people.

definition: the border of a state or country.
example_en: That village is located on the border of the state.

definition: a raised land; an extent of land higher in level than adjacent land.
example: ಹೊಲದ ನಡುವೆ ಒಂದು ಮೀಂಟೆ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A raised mound stood out in the middle of the field.

definition: a colourless, crystalline compound, potassium nitrate (KNO3) used in gunpowder, medicine, preservative, etc.; saltpetre.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಂದೂಕಿನ ಮದ್ದಿಗೆ ಪೆಟಲುಪ್ಪು ಬಳಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: In olden days they used saltpetre in gunpowder.

definition: an increasing or becoming increased; growth, enlargement; increase.
example_en: The increase in population has become a big problem.

definition: not happy; sorrowful.
example_en: He was sorrowful after failing in the examination.

definition: the act of or condition of being, joining together.
example_en: The joining of the two wooden pieces was tight.

definition: a touching or being touched; a physical contact; a touch.
example_en: The touch of the leaf was soft.

definition: to be or become equal.
example_en: Both sides of the account finally became equal.

definition: a tree that is born on the earth.
example_en: People worship that tree born of the earth.

definition: moving; not stationary.
example_en: That shadow swayed, moving in the wind.

definition: a boiling with heavy bubbling sound.
example_en: A heavy bubbling boil could be heard on the stove.

definition: a small ball of glass, etc, used to play with; a marble.
example_en: The child played by arranging the small glass marbles.

definition: a different colour.

definition: a hard, unmalleable alloy of iron made by casting: it contains a high proportion of carbon and silicon, has low tensile strength, and is very fluid and fusible when molten; cast iron.
example_en: In the factory, they make machine parts from cast iron.

definition: to become an integrated whole.
example_en: All the parts were becoming an integrated whole together.

definition: to be very anxious with full of mental distress or uneasiness because of fear; to be greatly worried.
example_en: While her husband was traveling, the wife was greatly worried.

definition: a disease of women connected with menstruation.
example_en: The doctor gave her treatment for the menstrual disease.

definition: without delay; at once; instantly; immediately.
example_en: He left immediately after hearing the news.

definition: the doctrine that everything, including one's choice of action, is the necessary result of a sequence of causes; determinism.
example_en: That philosopher strongly advocated determinism.

definition: to bring down; to cause to come down.
example_en: The workers brought down the wooden log.

definition: a kind of trap for catching fish.
example_en: The fishermen placed the fish-trap in the river.

definition: divided; separated.
example_en: That land is divided into two parts.

definition: to shine brightly; to be beautiful; to be distinguished.
example_en: The moon shone beautifully in the sky.

definition: to run or spill over the brim (said of a liquid in a container, water in a water tank, reservoir, etc.).
example_en: The bucket was full and the water was spilling over the brim.

definition: impatient eagerness.
example: ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಬರುವ ಮೊದಲು ಅವಳಲ್ಲಿ ತಹತಹ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Before the results came, her impatient eagerness increased.

definition: a ship having a sail by means of which it is propelled; a sail-boat.
example_en: A sail-ship stood at the harbour.

definition: full of force; powerful; forceful; strong; vigorous.
example: ಆ ಗಾಳಿ ಜಬರು ಆಗಿ ಮರಗಳನ್ನು ಬಗ್ಗಿಸಿತು.
example_en: That wind was so forceful that it bent the trees.

definition: a female house-sparrow.
example_en: That female house-sparrow brought grains to the nest.

definition: the act, process or fact of entering into; entrance.
example_en: The entrance of the cave was covered by bushes.

definition: the cardinal number forty; 40.
example_en: That book had forty pages.

definition: to cause to move or act more rapidly or too rapidly; to hurry; to hasten; to speed up.
example_en: He hurried the work along.

definition: the state of being scattered, strew around in a disorderly manner.

example_en: After the rain, the scattered state of the sown seeds was seen in the field.

definition: a small book; a booklet.
example_en: A small booklet was found in the library.

definition: a disorder of the muscles of the eyes, as cross-eye, in which both eyes cannot be focused on the same point at the same time; strabismus.
example_en: The doctor prescribed glasses for the strabismus problem.

definition: bitter voice or words.
example_en: Bitter words came out of his mouth.

definition: a condition characterised by lack of order or planning, by irregularity or by randomness; haphazardness.
example_en: In that office, all the work was carried out in a haphazard manner.

definition: the following of one thing after another in chronological, causal or logical order; succession or continuity; sequence.
example_en: The sequence of the program was carefully planned.

definition: a thin, flat or bowl-shaped dry cake of batter fried in a frying pan; a pancake.
example_en: While walking on the road we ate a dry pancake.

definition: that which said, uttered, stated; an account; a declaration or assertion.
example_en: The witness's statement was recorded in the court.

definition: the structure that unites the unborn mammal to the mother's womb establishing a nutritive connection between them; placenta.
example_en: Nourishing the fetus is the function of the placenta.

definition: spectacular feats done with an airplane, as loops or rolls; aerobatics.
example_en: The pilot's aerobatics amazed the onlookers.

definition: (the form, shape, configuration) to be lost.
example_en: The old picture's form was lost and could not be identified.

definition: to come together; to assemble.
example: ಹಬ್ಬದ ದಿನ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಗುಡಿಯ ಬಳಿ ಒರ್ಬುಳಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: On the festival day, everyone assembled near the temple.

definition: a forest; jungle; woods.
example_en: They went into the forest to hunt.

definition: no longer living; deprived of life; dead.
example_en: That warrior became dead in the battle.

definition: haughtiness, insolence, disdain; arrogance.
example_en: His arrogance annoyed everyone.

definition: the governing of a city, town etc.; the local government.
example: ಈ ನಗರದ ಉರಾಳ್ಚಿ ಜನರ ಸಹಭಾಗಿತ್ವದಿಂದ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The local governance of this city runs with people's participation.

definition: to abstain from taking food for a considerable period.
example_en: He abstained from food and prayed to God.

definition: to set apart for a certain purpose; to intend.
example_en: He had set apart that money for education.

definition: the quality of being soft, tender; softness; tenderness.
example_en: The tenderness of her voice captivated everyone.

definition: an earthen lid (for closing the mouth of an earthen pot or a vessel).
example_en: They covered the mouth of the pot with an earthen lid.

definition: any monetary coin of gold.
example_en: He had a gold coin with him.

definition: a woman who indulges in sexual relations with several men for pleasure or money.
example_en: The number of prostitutes was high in that town.

definition: that which is produced from or on the body.
example_en: This bodily product is generated from the body.

definition: one side of a leaf of a book, newspaper, letter, etc.; a page.
example_en: The twentieth page of the book has been torn.

definition: an Āyurvēdic tratment which is supposed to avoid aging or make one feel or seem young again or bring back to youthful strength, appearane, etc.
example_en: The sages became youthful again through the rejuvenation treatment.

definition: a gain or recurrent benefit usu. measured in money that derives from capital or labour; income.
example_en: This month's income has come in well.

definition: a valve with a device to control the movement, flow, etc. in a desired direction and to regulate the quantum so moving or flowing.
example: ಪೈಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಳವಡಿಸಿದ ತಡೆಕವಾಟ ನೀರಿನ ಹರಿವನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The check valve fitted in the pipe regulates the flow of water.

definition: contracted; shrunk in size.
example_en: The leaves appeared shrunk in the heat.

definition: oil exracted from castor beans.
example_en: They poured castor oil into the lamp.

definition: improper, unseemly, indecorous speech.
example: ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಚಿಲ್ಲರೆಮಾತು ಆಡಬೇಡ ಎಂದು ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಎಚ್ಚರಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: The grandmother warned him not to speak indecorous words in the assembly.

definition: to be or become confused, bewildered or perplexed and hence be unable to understand, foresee; to be baffled; to be confounded.
example_en: Hearing the sudden news, he was bewildered.

definition: an able, strong man.
example_en: That able, strong man defeated everyone in wrestling.

definition: a battle; a combat; a fight.
example: ಎರಡು ಸೈನ್ಯಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಘೋರ ಲಡಾಯಿ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: A fierce battle took place between the two armies.

definition: a female cuckoo.
example: ಆ ಕಲಕಂಠಿ ಮಾವಿನ ಮರದಲ್ಲಿ ಇಂಪಾಗಿ ಹಾಡಿತು.
example_en: That female cuckoo sang sweetly on the mango tree.

definition: that much.
example_en: He said that much money would be enough.

definition: a sequence of photographs or drawings, having a theme, story, etc., projected on a screen in such rapid succession that they create the optical illusion (because of the persistence of vision) of moving persons and objects; a film; a cinema.
example_en: We watched a new film on Sunday.

definition: a morbid affection of the lens of the eye.

definition: very soothing, pleasing speech.
example: ಕವಿಯ ಹೃದಯಂಗಮ ಮಾತುಗಳು ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮನ ಗೆದ್ದವು.
example_en: The poet's heart-touching, soothing words won everyone's heart.

definition: (the skin) to become thick and hardened; to become callous.
example_en: In summer his skin becomes thick and hardened.

definition: the tree Aglaia roxburghiana of Meliaceae family.
example: ಪ್ರಿಯಂಗು ಮರದ ಕೆಳಗೆ ನಾವು ವಿಶ್ರಾಂತಿ ಪಡೆದೆವು.
example_en: We rested under the Aglaia tree.

definition: an occupation or art calling for skilful use of the hands, as weaving, pottery, etc.; handicraft.
example_en: Weaving is her handicraft.

definition: a kind of cloth .
example_en: This kind of cloth is very soft.

definition: a good work, job.
example_en: He did a good work for the village.

definition: an act or instance of dismissing or expelling from an office, position, etc.; dismissal; expulsion.
example_en: The officer gave him an order of dismissal.

definition: the condition or fact of being absent; absence.
example: ಆ ಗ್ರಂಥದಲ್ಲಿ ದೇವರ ನಾಸ್ತಿತ್ವದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಚರ್ಚೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: That book discusses the absence of God.

definition: the space between two objects.
example: ಎರಡು ಮನೆಗಳ ನಡುವಂತರ ಬಹಳ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: The space between the two houses was very small.

definition: the backside of the throat.
example_en: The food got caught in the back of the throat.

definition: to go from place to place; to roam; to stroll.
example_en: The children roamed about the garden and played.

definition: to stick something with or on something with or as with glue.
example_en: He stuck the poster onto the wall.

definition: the office, status and authority of a forest-ranger.
example: ಅವನಿಗೆ ರೇಂಜರುಗಿರಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿತು.
example_en: After he got the office of forest-ranger, his responsibility increased.

definition: an inauspicious or unpropitious moment.
example_en: Do not start the journey at that inauspicious moment.

definition: the plant Aloe vera of Liliaceae family; a kind of aloe.
example_en: They were selling aloe leaves in the shop.

definition: acquaintance with facts, truths or principles, as from study or investigation; general erudition; knowledge.
example_en: He gained vast knowledge from his teachers.
